Restoration process:

  • Sourced from approximately 24 Mbps SD AVI files.
  • Deinterlaced using BWDIF with bottom-field-first parity.
  • Converted to 25fps progressive.
  • AI-assisted HD upscaling using Topaz Starlight Precise.
Important restoration note:

These files represent the initial Starlight Precise upscales. Whilst the model has produced some impressive improvements, it has also introduced unwanted artificial textures, including crosshatching and honeycomb-like patterns in certain scenes.

I'm currently developing my own source-guided restoration tools under Lew's Media Vault to soften these artefacts whilst retaining as much detail as possible. This involves comparing the original SD footage against the AI upscale and selectively replacing excessively reconstructed textures.

A refined V2 release is planned once I'm satisfied with the results. In the meantime, I'm making these initial upscales available for anyone who wishes to enjoy them.

Please note that these are unofficial AI-assisted remasters, not native HD masters.
